prerequisites: None. Competencies taught in Introduction to Cryptography and its Applications or IT Security are recommended.

learning_outcomes.text: can describe selected techniques for breaking security systems and cryptographic procedures

can implement these practically (implementation and project work), especially regarding server hardening, network security, computer-aided analysis of cryptographic procedures and security architectures
can name ethical and legal concerns of hacking

syllabus_topics: Practical techniques for breaking security systems and cryptographic procedures
Role of keys, IVs, and nonces in practical systems
Selected practically feasible attack techniques (Time-Memory-Tradeoffs, Password cracking, Meet-in-the-Middle attacks, statistical attacks)

assessment_methods.method: Weekly exercises, at least 50 percent of points achieved
Oral presentation of solutions for at least two exercises

assessment_rules: Grading is done with 0 to 15 points according to the examination regulations for the M.Sc. Computer Science degree program. To acquire ECTS, students must achieve at least 50% of the points from the weekly exercises and orally present the solution to at least two exercises. The final examination is either an oral examination or a written exam.
